Supported Power BI Dashboard and near real time Use cases to stream data from IoT devices. Solution Design Review in Architecture Review Board, IT Landscape Design and New requirement solution design and Optimize Azure cost. Azure Data Factory Pipeline setup, PySpark, AI/ML, Deep Learning, Python, Azure Functions, C++, C#. NET, CI/CD using Azure DevOps Pipelines, Terraform, IaC.

o

Development of Shell Global Asset tracking system. Asset Information Management is a distributed enterprise system that integrates data stored in SAP R3 with data stored in Oracle 10 and electronic documents stored in IBM FileNet P8 and is in use for about 15+ years within the Shell organization with thousands of users. The development process is SCRUM based, Python and C#.NET, CI , CD using Azure DevOps Pipelines, Terraform, Microservices, IT Landscape Design. o Main Responsibilities: Implement Solution Design, and new functionality in the system and improve overall quality

and stability. Worked for Multiple releases, Build and Release processes.
